one_pagers.headline: Advent has 3 direct precedents in Healthcare Services, Behavioral Health and Physician Groups, and a $200.0M target sits inside its deal range
one_pagers.overview: Advent International is a Financial Sponsor with 18 deals in the data, 15 closed, from 2016 to 2024 (F1, F3). Deal sizes run from $13.5M (MA-2016-0302) to $5,536.6M (MA-2016-0231), with a median of $124.0M (F13). It buys in Behavioral Health (3), Dental (3), Health Insurance (3) and Revenue Cycle (3), among others (F4, F5, F6, F8). It closed 3 deals in 2023-2024, the last in 2024 Q4 (MA-2024-0042) (F15).
one_pagers.fit_thesis: Advent has 3 direct precedents: MA-2021-0341, MA-2023-0108 and MA-2024-0120 (F19). Two are in Behavioral Health, which is its largest healthcare-adjacent sector at a similarity of 0.77 (F4). It also has 1 Physician Groups deal at 0.83 (F10). The target's $200.0M EV is larger than 61% of its deals (F14). Its 3 direct precedents sit above the peer median of 2 (F30). Its 1 Healthcare Services deal matches the peer median of 1, so that count does not set it apart (F9, F29). Its 3 deals in 2023-2024 equal the peer median of 3, so recent pace is typical (F15, F26). Its regional mix of 13 of 18 deals (72%) is near the peer median of 80%, so regional focus is not distinctive (F18, F33). Its 3 direct precedents match Nordic Capital, Bain Capital and New Mountain Capital, so that count does not separate it from them. The data doesn't show a platform or add-on pattern.
one_pagers.precedent_commentary: MA-2024-0120 is the most relevant precedent. It is a 2024 Healthcare Services deal at $303.9M, closed at 9.3x EV/EBITDA and 3.36x EV/Revenue. MA-2021-0341 (Behavioral Health, $163.0M, 13.2x) and MA-2023-0108 (Behavioral Health, $123.0M, 14.6x) complete the direct set. MA-2021-0072 and MA-2019-0027 are not direct, because one is below $100.0M EV and the other is from 2019.
one_pagers.valuation_commentary: The market comps are 10 closed Healthcare Services deals at $100.0M-$400.0M, with a median EV/EBITDA of 12.1x and a median EV/Revenue of 2.90x (F22). Advent's 3 direct precedents have a median EV/EBITDA of 13.2x (F20). Across its 15 closed deals, the median is 15.5x EV/EBITDA and 3.19x EV/Revenue (F23). The data doesn't show what Advent would pay for this target.
one_pagers.conviction_reason: Conviction is High because Advent has 3 direct precedents, which meets the threshold of 3 or more (F19, F34). It also has 1 deal in Healthcare Services (F21). The normal-severity data risk does not lower the level.

one_pagers.headline: TPG Capital: 2 direct precedents and a $200.0M target above most of its deal sizes, rated Medium
one_pagers.overview: TPG Capital is a Financial Sponsor with 18 deals in the data, 15 of them closed, from 2016 to 2023 (F1, F3). Deal sizes run from $7.0M (MA-2023-0110) to $1,387.8M (MA-2022-0172), with a median of $87.5M (F12). It buys across Physician Groups (3), Behavioral Health (3), Health Insurance (4), Dental (2) and Health IT (3) (F4-F8). It has 1 deal in 2023-2024 against a peer median of 3 (F14, F25).
one_pagers.fit_thesis: The target is private, and TPG Capital's private share is 11 of 18 deals (61%) against a peer median of 36% (F15, F30). That is a trait that sets it apart from peers. The $200.0M EV is larger than 78% of its deals, so this would be a bigger-than-usual deal for it (F13). It has 2 direct precedents, MA-2021-0369 and MA-2022-0350, matching the peer median of 2 (F18, F29). Its 3 Physician Groups deals and 3 Behavioral Health deals sit close to Healthcare Services, at similarity 0.83 and 0.77 (F4, F5). Regional targets (13 of 18, 72%) and margin at or above 16.8% (7 of 18, 39%) are near peer medians of 80% and 39%, so they are not specific to TPG Capital (F16, F17, F31, F32). Outside the data: platform versus add-on fit, exit path and holding period are not shown.
one_pagers.precedent_commentary: The two direct precedents matter most: MA-2022-0350 (Healthcare Services, $186.6M, 11.2x EV/EBITDA) and MA-2021-0369 (Behavioral Health, $117.9M, 8.8x). Both closed. The other three Physician Groups deals are $7.0M to $23.1M, well below the target's $200.0M, so they show sector exposure but not size fit. MA-2018-0111 is Pending.
one_pagers.valuation_commentary: The 10 market comps show a median EV/EBITDA of 12.1x and a median EV/Revenue of 2.90x (F21). TPG Capital's 2 direct precedents show a median EV/EBITDA of 10.0x (F19). Across its 15 closed deals, the medians are 15.7x EV/EBITDA and 2.43x EV/Revenue (F22). The data doesn't show what drives the spread between these figures.
one_pagers.conviction_reason: Conviction is Medium because TPG Capital has 2 direct precedents, short of the 3 needed for High, and 1 deal in Healthcare Services (F18, F20, F33). The Competitive process risk is normal severity, so it does not lower the level (F34).
